source.name: USDA MyPlate Kitchen
source.credit: Adapted from University of Minnesota Cooperative Extension Service

steps.instruction: Wash your hands, then clean the utensils and counter top.
steps.spoken: Wash your hands with soap and water. Make sure the utensils and counter top are clean.

steps.instruction: Mix 1 cup of mashed banana, 1/2 cup of yogurt and 1/4 cup of water.
Add 1 cup of quick oats and mix well.
steps.spoken: Add 1 cup of quick oats, not instant oats, and mix well.

steps.instruction: Add 1/2 cup of raisins or sunflower seeds if you like, and mix well.
Add cinnamon to taste if you like, and mix well.
Check that the batter is thick and easy to scoop with a spoon.
Place 1 tablespoon of dough on the sheet and press it into a flat disk.
steps.spoken: Place 1 tablespoon of dough on the sheet and press it lightly into a flat disk. Repeat with the rest of the dough.

steps.instruction: Refrigerate any dough left in the bowl.
Flip the cookies and bake 15 more minutes to make 25 small crisp cookies.
steps.spoken: Flip the cookies and bake them 15 more minutes, until they are crisp. This makes 25 small cookies.
